profile.headline: Software Engineer, Autonomy at Rivian
profile.summary: Software Engineer with extensive experience in safety critical embedded systems. Dedicated to provide solutions to problems sets that arise through the analytical discovery process.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, Autonomy
positions.description:
Gen 2: 
• Assist with the design and lead the development of the camera framework that enabled various applications to access the camera streams while following the OpenVX specification. 
• Lead the development and integration of various device drivers to support the camera pipeline on Nvidia's DriveOS platform running on an Nvidia Orin SoC. 
• Perform bring-up of the Autonomy Module with fellow embedded and hardware team members. Tailored the BSP to satisfy requests from the Autonomy team, implemented some diagnostic components for the platform, and worked with various vendors to troubleshoot any bring-up oddities. 
• Work with our Electrical Design Engineering team to identify and confirm support for various software diagnostics and communication pathways. Analyzed data intensive pathways to ensure available hardware bandwidth can satisfy the various ADAS functionalities. 

Gen 1:
• Collaborate with suppliers and perform software bring-up activities for vision modules
• Integrate and debug vision modules on various vehicle platforms
• Work with Autonomy teams to develop and integrate ADAS features to run on ARM based Linux & RTOS based embedded systems
• Build and integrate various lab equipment to automate testing and provide remote access to development boards for the Autonomy team

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Develop, integrate, and test embedded software applications on Software-Defined Radios (SDR).
• Review requirements, generated design artifacts, and performed code reviews.
• Support the transition to Agile and share best practices with other teams.

Freedom Radio Software Development:
• Implemented and debugged bootloader features in AArch64 & C++ to deploy on Xilinx Zynq UltraScale+ RFSoC Dev Boards and target hardware.
• Debugged GreenHills Integrity-178 tuMP RTOS ARM64 kernel during board bring-up.
• Modified and rebuilt PowerPC native applications to deploy on ARM64 hardware.
• Developed health status self-checking features for Xilinx Zynq UltraScale+ RFSoC.
• Analyzed 3rd party secure/non-secure Link 16 application and modified the codebase to deploy on the SDR.

positions.locationName: San Diego County, California, United States

positions.title: Staff Software Developer
positions.description:
• Analyzed and decomposed customer requirements to produce software architecture & software requirements for the proposed Air Vehicle & Control Station.
• Led the software development of unmanned air-to-air refueling (AAR) capability.
• Rapid prototype development of AAR interface control software between flight computer, mission computer, and AAR components.
• Developed the air vehicle and control station software architecture.
• Produced the software development & release schedule with labor estimations that was incorporated into the Integrated Master Schedule (IMS).

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
• Performed software development for the Predator B aircraft, primarily for the USAF MQ-9 UAS. 
• Led a team developing the software requirements for the flight control software and air vehicle management subsystems.
• Participated in the R&D efforts for the Predator B Extended Range which involved developing and integrating software components associated with the new hardware. 
• Investigated and resolved over 40+ fielded software anomalies utilizing various root cause analysis methods.

positions.title: Undergraduate Researcher
positions.description:
GreenDroid project:
• Analyzed software revisions to generate patch code instructions as a basis for design. 
• Designed an execution unit in SystemVerilog to handle patch code instructions to promote the longevity of customized, application-specific circuit called the C-Core.

positions.title: Musical Instruments Specialist
positions.description: • Worked with customers and training them to use musical instruments & recording tools.

positions.title: Computer Sales Associate
positions.description:
• Developed and implemented sales strategy goals to adapt to current shopping habits. 
• Coached team members to provide impressionable customer service. 
• Worked with management to develop merchandizing techniques resulting in exceeded budgeted sales goals

positions.title: Network Information Systems Technician Intern
positions.description: • Assisted with the management of a 3000+ user network and maintained school website.

projects.title: Discretized Capacitance Calculation
projects.description: Formulated MATLAB code that discretely calculated the capacitance across charged plates. After calculation, a graph was provided as a visual representation of the calculation. The code modeled an accurate representation of the capacitance versus the approximation equation.

projects.title: Image Processing
projects.description: Analyzed different Fourier transforms on a raw image to compress the overall file size in MATLAB. The algorithm developed produced a compressed image with little to no noticeable artifacts after processing.
